description: Adaptive Multi-KPI Radial Performance Matrix by Office Solution The Adaptive Multi-KPI Radial Performance Matrix visualizes multi-dimensional balanced scorecards and operational performance across entities in Power BI. It combines multi-series polar radar polygons with customizable spoke axes, target progress arcs, small multiples, and animated chronological scenario playback into a single responsive visual. Key Concepts: Multi-Spoke Polar Grid: Compare multiple performance dimensions simultaneously on a unified radial coordinate system. Dual Scaling Models: Switch between Absolute Scale for raw magnitude and Normalized Scale (0–100%) for metrics with diverse units. Target & Benchmark Layers: Gauge KPI attainment with concentric on-spoke progress arcs and dashed benchmark reference boundaries. Key Features: Dual View Modes: Toggle seamlessly between an overlaid Single Radar view and a Small Multiples grid. Dynamic Field Switching: Place multiple columns into field wells to swap active dimensions directly from toolbar dropdowns. Scenario & Timeline Playback: Animate period-over-period or quarterly performance morphing with play/pause and scrub slider. Spoke Target Progress Arcs: Color-coded green/orange attainment arcs along each spoke highlighting on-target status. Compare Matrix Drawer: Slide out side-by-side executive benchmark tables for in-depth KPI breakdown. Responsive…
